business_summary: HYUNDAI MOVEX Co., Ltd. operates in the information technology (IT) and logistics system businesses in South Korea and internationally. It offers engineering solutions based on system construction; logistics services to the distribution/parcel, freezing/cooling, tire, petrochemical, airport, pharmaceutical, automobile, manufacturing, hospital, food and beverage, clothing, and process logistics sectors; consulting services for design support, factory automation, and material handling automation; and platform screen doors. The company also provides IT consulting services for information system development, business process reengineering/process innovation, IT governance, and ERP; cloud services, such as consulting, system building, data migration, and managed services; IT outsourcing; IT infrastructure services, including network integration, data center, and disaster recovery; groupware; and smart grids and integrated wings. In addition, it builds IT infrastructures for the construction, logistics, port, public, financial, and manufacturing sectors; and provides IoT, cloud computing, and big data services. Further, the company offers U& Terminal Container, an operating system for terminal environments; U& Terminal Bulk, an operating system for multi-purpose terminals; U& Terminal Auto, a terminal automation solution; and U& Terminal iMax, a system that connects the TOS, transfer equipment, and location detection systems to collect data on terminal operations and equipment usage. Additionally, it provides U& Vessel solution that offers operation management procedures for maritime shipping companies; U& Vessel Insight, a management solution for vessel energy use reduction and route optimization; U& Shipping, a shipping company operating system; U& SmartStow, a system for vessel's safety and cargo capacity efficiency; WMS, OMS, and TMS solutions; and U&Rfaz, a wireless communication security solution. HYUNDAI MOVEX Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 현대무벡스(주)는 한국 및 해외에서 정보 기술(IT) 및 물류 시스템 사업을 운영하고 있습니다. 시스템 구축을 기반으로 엔지니어링 솔루션을 제공합니다. 유통/소포, 냉동/냉각, 타이어, 석유화학, 공항, 제약, 자동차, 제조, 병원, 식품 및 음료, 의류 및 공정 물류 부문에 대한 물류 서비스; 설계 지원, 공장 자동화, 자재 취급 자동화를 위한 컨설팅 서비스; 그리고 플랫폼 스크린도어. 또한, 정보시스템 개발, 비즈니스 프로세스 리엔지니어링/프로세스 혁신, IT 거버넌스, ERP 등을 위한 IT 컨설팅 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다. 컨설팅, 시스템 구축, 데이터 마이그레이션, 관리형 서비스 등의 클라우드 서비스; IT 아웃소싱; 네트워크 통합, 데이터 센터 및 재해 복구를 포함한 IT 인프라 서비스 그룹웨어; 스마트 그리드 및 통합 날개. 또한 건설, 물류, 항만, 공공, 금융, 제조 분야의 IT 인프라를 구축합니다. IoT, 클라우드 컴퓨팅, 빅데이터 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 테이크아웃용 운영체제인 U& Terminal Container를 제공하고 있습니다.
